candidates.quote: Tenant may renew this Lease for one (1) additional period of five (5) years (the “Renewal Term”), by delivering written notice of the exercise thereof to Landlord between Lease Months 31 and 34 (or earlier).

candidates.value: Landlord prior written consent is required to assign, sublet, encumber, or license occupancy, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Consent is not required, upon 15 business days' prior written notice and if no monetary default exists, for an assignment to a merger or consolidation successor, a transferee of substantially all assets, or a commonly controlled entity, if the transfer is for a good business purpose and the successor's tangible net worth is at least equal to Tenant's. Landlord may terminate the Lease as to the space in lieu of consenting to an assignment or a sublease of substantially all of the Premises for substantially all of the remaining term.
candidates.quote: Tenant shall not directly or indirectly, by operation of law or otherwise, assign, sublet, mortgage, hypothecate or otherwise encumber all or any portion of its interest in this Lease or in the Premises or grant any license in any person other than Tenant or its employees to use or occupy the Premises or any part thereof without obtaining the prior written consent of Landlord, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed.
